info.title: AI Sana Platform API
info.description: The practical-task platform core (profiles, teams, catalog, evidence, points) and the modules: Startup Sprint (case 1), Business Challenge Builder (case 2), Challenge Match (case 3). Authorisation: a Supabase Auth access token in the Authorization: Bearer header.

Role.description: The user role on the platform

orgName.description: For the business role: the company name

source.description: Where it comes from: the business's answers, or 'not specified'

downloadUrl.description: A temporary link to the file (when one is uploaded)

awarded.description: All awards linked to this evidence

explanation.description: A human-readable explanation of the award

adjustPoints.description: Only for adjust: a mandatory-comment adjustment — to the team, or to the author for individual work

evidence.description: For a business — only confirmed items

startDate.description: Sprint start; defaults to today. Planned stage dates are computed from it.

target.description: stage — close the current stage; task — close a task; interview — another client interview (does not close the stage)

changes.description: What changed relative to the previous turn

quoteVerified.description: The quote was found in the business's messages

estHours.description: Estimated effort in hours for the whole project

requirementsConfirmed.description: The business representative saw and confirmed the team requirements

reasons.description: Why the team fits the task

skillsToAdd.description: Skills missing for harder tasks, and how many tasks they would unlock

points.description: Awarded for this quiz (first attempt only)

check.description: null when the model was unavailable; the teacher reviews the work
null when the model was unavailable; the teacher reviews the work

minutesToSend.description: Reference only — it does not add points

contribution.description: Contribution by actions; messages do not count

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page, or null

assignmentId.description: For an accepted application — the task assigned to the team

projectId.description: Startup Sprint project the task is attached to
